name: ethicalai-workspace
description: Root workspace for EthicalAI AI Risk Assessment platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.setup:ml: cd ml-service && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv\Scripts\python model\train.py
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ml"
